name: HandbookHub
tagline: Search employee handbooks and read saved policies with source links.
description: Connect to HandbookHub's hosted MCP service to list authorized handbooks, browse page structures, search policies, and read source pages. Four read-only tools use scoped, revocable bearer tokens. Requires eligible HandbookHub access and an organization-owner-created API token. The integration files are MIT licensed; the hosted application is proprietary. Setup: https://handbookhub.com/mcp

install.notes: Replace YOUR_API_TOKEN with your own token in local client settings. Create it in HandbookHub Settings > API access as the organization owner, selecting allowed handbooks and expiry. Requires Starter/Growth access, an active subscription trial, or the included two-week Growth bonus. No OAuth. See https://handbookhub.com/mcp.
